{{Quote|They say there's no problem you can't solve with ingenuity, good tools, and sufficient time. Sometimes, I wonder what it's like to have those latter two things.|Chalan Talosi|<ref name="Special Mods">''[[Special Modifications]]''</ref>}}
'''Chalan Talosi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] who served aboard a ship with [[Javlin/Legends|Javlin]] and [[WAC-77/Legends|WAC-77]]. At one point they were pursued by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and Talosi had to scramble to fix the ship. She once spoke about the tools available to the profession.<ref name="Special Mods" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chalan Talosi appears in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2016]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Special Modifications]]''.<ref name="Special Mods" />
